A0144.title: Software-Level Side-Channel Mitigation
A0144.definition: Reducing side-channel information leakage through software implementation techniques
A0144.description: Software-layer protection: constant-time cryptographic libraries; avoiding key-dependent branches; memory access pattern obfuscation; using bit masks instead of conditionals; periodic key rotation; minimizing the scope of privileged code.
A0144.limitation: Software-based methods have limited effectiveness, may impact performance, and are difficult to completely eliminate leakage; constant-time implementations can still be bypassed by advanced side-channel attacks such as cache timing and branch prediction, and attackers can amplify timing differences through simulators or controlled environments to circumvent obfuscation and masking defenses.

references.title: IP Defending Against Voltage Side-Channel Hacking - Anquanke
